answer_1.quote: Data-to-text generation is the task of converting structured data into natural language text that can be easily understood by humans.
answer_1.outputs: Generated natural language descriptions/verbalizations of tables, knowledge graph triples, and meaning representations.

answer_2.quote: We also use the NLI score on the LogicNLG dataset to evaluate the logical fidelity... We evaluate the quality of generated texts using several widely accepted metrics. BLEU ... METEOR ... TER ... PARENT ... NIST ... CIDEr.
